import json, subprocess, sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0, 'tmp'); sys.path.insert(0, 'submission')
import ref, main as M
# stress: many distinct surviving core paths on a 64-node cycle
N = 64
cyc = [1000 + 11*i for i in range(N)]
rib = []
rnd = random.Random(2)
for L in range(2, 21):
    for s in range(N):
        p = [cyc[(s+j) % N] for j in range(L)]
        rib.append({'path': p, 'count': rnd.randint(1, 1000)})
        rib.append({'path': p[::-1], 'count': rnd.randint(1, 1000)})
print("rib records:", len(rib))
agg = {}
for r in rib:
    t = tuple(r['path']); agg[t] = agg.get(t, 0) + r['count']
print("distinct paths:", len(agg), "total occurrences:", sum(len(p)-1 for p in agg))
final, rounds = ref.ref_peel(agg)
core = set()
for p in final:
    for i in range(len(p)-1): core.add(ref.canon(p[i], p[i+1]))
occs = ref.ref_occurrences(final)
order = ref.find_order(ref.scope_graph(occs, core))
print("final paths:", len(final), "core:", len(core), "order ok:", order is not None)
print("occurrences in final:", sum(len(p)-1 for p in final))
doc = {'version':1,'ixps':[],'rib':rib,'priors':[],'declared':[],'order':[[u,v] for u,v in order],
       'queries':[{'id':'q%d'%i,'path':[cyc[(i+j)%N] for j in range(64)],'threshold':[1,2]} for i in range(512)]}
data = json.dumps(doc).encode()
t0=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=data,capture_output=True,cwd='/workspace')
t1=time.time()
out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print("elapsed %.2fs rc %d links %d queries %d" % (t1-t0, p.returncode, len(out.get('links',[])), len(out.get('queries',[]))))
if p.stderr: print("stderr:", p.stderr.decode()[:400])
EOF
